segments.t: 伊芙琳听到了动静，从外面的花园探头往里看。在这个布满灰尘的大房间中央，一块白色的床单覆盖着一个高大的木制物体。如果准备好了，我们就开始听场景四。
Good morning! Why is everyone standing inside the hallway wall?
Come look, Miss Evelyn! We found Room Nine!
Goodness, look at those arched windows! May I step inside?
Watch the dusty threshold, ma'am. Help me fold this white sheet.
One, two... oh! Look at the dark polished wood!
An upright piano! A real walnut upright piano!
Careful with the lid. It has been closed for decades.
Look at the ivory keys, Hannah. They are clean and whole.
Go ahead, Miss Evelyn, play a chord for the house!
Listen... a little low, very warm, and wait, middle D makes no sound!
Every key sings except one stubborn note in the middle?
Give an old piano one good repair, Graham, and it remembers every song.
现在我们来拆解这个场景中的关键表达。
Good morning! Why is everyone standing inside the hallway wall?
‘早上好！为什么每个人都挤在走廊的墙里？’伊芙琳幽默的提问使用了
Why is everyone
这是一个非常实用的介词短语，表示“在这个空间内部”。
Come look, Miss Evelyn! We found Room Nine!
‘快来看，伊芙琳小姐！我们找到九号房间了！’如果想邀请别人过来一起分享发现
Come look
既传达了兴奋又十分自然友好。
Goodness, look at those arched windows! May I step inside?
‘哎呀，看那些拱形窗户！我可以进去吗？’为了请求允许踏入一个房间或空间，动词 step 加上介词
May I step inside?
构成了完美的组合。
Watch the dusty threshold, ma'am. Help me fold this white sheet.
‘小心布满灰尘的门槛，女士。帮我折叠这块白床单。’为了提醒某人注意脚下的障碍物，我们用
Watch the dusty threshold
搭配 the dusty threshold（布满灰尘的门槛）。
One, two... oh! Look at the dark polished wood!
‘一，二……哦！看看这深色抛光的木头！’这里形容词放在前面修饰木头：
dark polished wood
指的是它深邃的颜色和光滑的表面。
An upright piano! A real walnut upright piano!
‘一架立式钢琴！一架真正的胡桃木立式钢琴！’因为 upright 以元音音素开头，所以前面的冠词要加 n：
An upright piano
之所以这么叫，是因为它的琴弦是垂直向上的，而不是像三角钢琴那样平放。
Careful with the lid. It has been closed for decades.
‘小心琴盖。它已经关了几十年了。’表示很久以前被关上，直到这一秒依然保持关闭状态，我们使用
has been closed
搭配 for decades（几十年）。
Look at the ivory keys, Hannah. They are clean and whole.
‘看这些象牙琴键，汉娜。它们干净又完整。’请注意这里的
keys
在英语中，它既可以指接待台上的黄铜钥匙，也可以指钢琴上的琴键。
Go ahead, Miss Evelyn, play a chord for the house!
‘去吧，伊芙琳小姐，为客栈弹个和弦吧！’鼓励某人不要害羞大胆去做，我们用
Go ahead
请记住 play 既可以表示玩耍，也可以表示演奏乐器。
Listen... a little low, very warm, and wait, middle D makes no sound!
‘听……声音有点低沉，非常温暖，等等，中央的 D 音不响！’在英语中，音符用从 A（la）到 G（sol）的字母表示：C 是 do，而
middle D
是键盘中央的 re 音。
Every key sings except one stubborn note in the middle?
‘除了中间一个顽固的音符，每一根琴键都在唱歌吗？’就像 everyone 一样，
Every key sings
后面的动词使用带有词尾 s 的单数形式，尽管它说的是所有的琴键。
Give an old piano one good repair, Graham, and it remembers every song.
‘给这架旧钢琴好好修一下，格雷厄姆，它会想起每一首歌的。’祈使句后面跟 and 就像是一个温暖的承诺：先做这件事，你马上就会看到结果。让我们不间断地再听一遍整个场景。

Come look, Miss Evelyn! We found Room Nine!
Goodness, look at those arched windows! May I step inside?
Watch the dusty threshold, ma'am. Help me fold this white sheet.
One, two... oh! Look at the dark polished wood!
An upright piano! A real walnut upright piano!
Careful with the lid. It has been closed for decades.
Look at the ivory keys, Hannah. They are clean and whole.
Go ahead, Miss Evelyn, play a chord for the house!
Listen... a little low, very warm, and wait, middle D makes no sound!
Every key sings except one stubborn note in the middle?
Give an old piano one good repair, Graham, and it remembers every song.
在保护床单下面，静静躺着一架发出温暖声音的胡桃木钢琴，除了中央一个发不出声音的琴键外，其他琴键都在歌唱。我们下个场景见。
Goodbye!
